mechanism: Both agents are antiepileptic drugs with additive CNS depression; valproic acid may inhibit levetiracetam metabolism and increase its levels, while levetiracetam does not significantly affect valproic acid metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased CNS adverse effects (sedation, dizziness, behavioral changes); therapeutic drug monitoring of valproic acid levels may be warranted; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is essential.
